title: Sources, qualification incidents and volatility boundary
summary: This sphere combines current public Colab CLI documentation with live qualified operational evidence. Volatile provider surfaces are dated and must be re-probed. Durable lessons are the separations: installed capability vs documentation, request vs observation, secret vs ordinary environment, transport fault vs deterministic failure, execution success vs promotion success, and ephemeral provider state vs durable returned artifacts.
evidence_note: Public sources consulted 2026-09-02: PyPI google-colab-cli 0.6.0; github.com/googlecolab/google-colab-cli README and colab-operator skill; Google Colab local-runtime security documentation. Project evidence: Gemma-ooRexx dev9-dev23 Colab qualification sequence and managed-compute/Secret-Broker integration.
invariants: Public upstream main is not pinned-release capability evidence.
Project incidents are exact observations, not universal provider guarantees.
When public docs and installed help differ, adapt to installed capability and record the discrepancy.
